description: Spell a number out in words: cardinal (e.g. "seven"), ordinal (e.g. "7th"), or currency (e.g. "seven dollars"). Requires a math.tools API token (numbers:* ability).

lang.description: Locale for cardinal/currency, e.g. 'en_US', 'fr_FR'. Not used for ordinal (English only). Defaults to the site default.

name: spell-number
title: Spell Number Tool
